svg.text: P2P protocol — Responder R (finite state machine)
Mealy machine: each arrow is event [guard] / action. The number on an arrow refers to the table below.
k ← 1, e ← x+2, idle ← 0, send PONG(x+1, a_R), start_timer(W)
send ERROR(x, out of sync): R lost its state (reboot) or session ended
recv other frame or stray timeout
k++, e ← x+2, idle ← 0, send PONG(x+1, a_R), restart_timer(W)
idle ← 0, resend(last_msg), restart_timer(W): our PONG was lost
restart session as in 1: I rebooted and began again
recv PING [x older or ahead] or invalid
log "initiator silent": ABANDONED (I gave up, or END was lost)
Variables (EFSM): e = counter expected in the next PING · k = completed rounds · idle = silent timeouts in a row · W = 2000 ms · 10 = MAX + 2 (outlasts I's resends)
Every other event in a state is listed in the code and only logged (Appendix C.2). R has no final state: after a session it waits for the next one.
